name: development-windmill
about: On the development map (451), a Westfall windmill seen from beside it, flying in its blades' shade, in first person; then 200 yards out, the camera turned all the way round, and back (2026-10-04, the owner). Four faults of its shade, all on this windmill: its parts were too small for the far map one by one (minTriangles), so its shade came in steps; batches of windmills drawn from afar held frozen poses under the turning blades; the windmill's blades, out of view in first person, went as an "older pose" when its tower's edge was drawn; and its stone tower cast as leaves because its sails are alpha tested. The owner's snapshot controls; the owner's snapshot place and sun. Last, from 90 yards, flying, in first person, where its parts must all be in the far map; the probe is taken there. Before going out and after coming back, a 5 s recording in the normal view and one in Debug View 5 (the shade alone), so the blades' shade is seen turning (2026-10-05, the owner); from 90 yards, shots in both views. Since 2026-10-04 the windmill is a record in the object table, its parts filed under it.

start.about: the owner's snapshot: 12 yards over the ground (293.9) beside the windmill, in its blades' shade; the camera faced -139.3 degrees, 28.2 down, in first person; the sun from their probe, azimuth 45, elevation 47.1

record.label: beside it, before going out, Debug View 5

expect.about: At the start, in first person with the windmill behind the camera, its blades are kept in its record
expect.probe: object part: animated doodad at [(]4359[.]7 -215[.]4 .*30 triangles.*alpha tested

expect.about: All four of its parts are in the far map (each alone is under minTriangles)
expect.probe: object part: animated doodad at [(]4359[.]7 -215[.]4 .*, (108|88|60|30) triangles,.*the far map's last redraw: in it

expect.about: One record holds the windmill: the cache keeps no entry at an animated doodad, so no second pose
expect.probe: ^shadow: 0 cache entries at animated doodads within 300 yd

expect.about: Its tower (108 triangles) casts as solid
expect.probe: object part: animated doodad at [(]4359[.]7 -215[.]4 .*, 108 triangles,.*casts as solid

expect.about: Its clock is set from the client's pose: all four parts know their bones, and the match is close
expect.probe: object clock: animated doodad at [(]4359[.]7 -215[.]4 [0-9.]+[)]: timed, .*error 0[.]00.*parts' bones( [0-9]+:0,1,2){4}$

expect.about: Every windmill's clock is set, the batched ones far off too, so each one's blades turn out of view
Its sails (alpha tested, 30 triangles) cast as leaves
expect.probe: object part: animated doodad at [(]4359[.]7 -215[.]4 .*, 30 triangles,.*casts as leaves
